'''Pallies''' were juicy, sweet [[Fruit/Legends|fruits]]<ref name="Jira" /> and sold in the markets of [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Among the distributors were [[Jira/Legends|Jira]], a friend of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].<ref name="Jira" />
